text:
Alex (Product): quick UX check — the audit log feels hard to reach from the roles matrix. noticed multiple folks clicking around. thoughts?
Maya (Design): yep. users expect a 'view audit' affordance near role rows. current path: Org settings > Audit > filter by role = 4 clicks.
Jon (Eng): curious — do we want a per-row network call when clicking 'view audit'? Could instead deep-link to audit panel with a hash + filter param. less backend churn.
Priya (PM): deep-link pattern sounds good. Important: when we come from an invite flow (or SSO toggle) we should preserve context (actor, time range).
Maya (Design): mock idea: small inline secondary link under role name: "View audit for this role" (16px, muted). Hover gives tooltip "Open audit with role filter".
Sam (Accessibility): must ensure focus management and announcement. If jumping, set focus to panel and use an aria-live region: "Audit panel opened, 12 results". Also `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded` on the jump trigger.
Jon (Eng): implementable. plan: anchor link -> router navigates to /orgs/:id/audit#role=role_id, then client parses hash, fetches filtered events, and focuses panel. Will add `role` param to API cache key.
Maya (Design): copy nits: prefer "View audit for role" vs "this role"? shorter helps in cramped rows.
Priya (PM): shorter is better. Also we need to prevent accidental nav if user has unsaved changes in role editor. show a confirmation toast if dirty.
Tess (Design Intern): uploaded a micro-proto in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/audit-jump-proto — shows inline link and focused panel state.
Maya (Design): added a subtle focus ring (2px) and increased contrast on hover.
Sam (Accessibility): sample code suggestion:
```html
<button id="audit-jump-42" aria-controls="audit-panel" aria-expanded="false" class="inline-link">View audit for role</button>
<main id="audit-panel" tabindex="-1" aria-live="polite"></main>
```
Jon (Eng): will implement focus set with `document.getElementById('audit-panel').focus()` after fetch completes. also add `role` param to telemetry.
Alex (Product): can we A/B test the inline link vs floating CTA? start with 10% of orgs.
Priya (PM): +1. Metrics: clickthrough to audit, time-to-first-event, and support tickets mentioning "can't find audit".
Jon (Eng): timeline: 2d spike (router hash + focus pattern), 3d implementation, 1d QA. I'll spin up a ticket and PR draft.
Maya (Design): microcopy decision: final = "View audit for role". Accessibility note: include visually-hidden text: "View audit for role {role name}".
Sam (Accessibility): and keyboard: ensure link is reachable as first tabbable item in row. test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Jon (Eng): PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987 — contains router handling + focus flow.
Alex (Product): great. Action items: Jon: ticket + PR, Maya: update mocks with final copy + focus states, Sam: add checklist for keyboard + screenreader smoke tests, Priya: configure 10% canary & metrics.
Maya (Design): small follow-up — for SSO toggle changes, show a tiny pill above audit panel: "Filters: SSO=on, role=Admin" when opened.
Priya (PM): yes, helpful. keep it dismissible.
Sam (Accessibility): ensure pill has clear semantics; using `role=status` and `aria-live=polite` works for dynamic filter labels.
Alex (Product): all set. thanks everyone :tada:
